name: blackraptor-marketing
description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. A governed, full-stack marketing department: specialist agents (brand, naming/trademark, market research, content, copy, creative, SEO/GEO, paid media, social/community, email/outbound, video, competitive intel, pricing, analytics, and a campaign coordinator) hub-and-spoke around a shared Marketing Intelligence Core context file. Encodes verified best-practice methodologies (Dillman survey design, Kohavi experimentation, IPA/Binet & Field creative effectiveness, Ehrenberg-Bass distinctive assets, Made to Stick / NN-g writing craft), including trademark/name research, a compliance-gated claims engine, and pricing/willingness-to-pay modeling. Auto-pulls the blackraptor-core pack (evidence-auditor adversarial research gate + research-integrity skill + product-manager). Hard rules baked in: no autonomous sends, posts, or spend — agents draft, humans approve.
